component.name: Cherry Studio
component.summary: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants

description.p: This is a community package of Cherry Studio, maintained independently and unaffiliated with CherryHQ. It repackages the official upstream Linux Debian build unmodified.

Cherry Studio is an AI productivity studio that unifies access to frontier LLMs. It brings smart chat, autonomous agents and a library of 300+ assistants into one desktop client, and connects just as happily to models running locally through Ollama or LM Studio.

ul.li: Talk to 300+ models from one window, with provider keys kept in your system keyring.
Point the same client at a local Ollama or LM Studio server for fully offline conversations.
Hand a task to an autonomous agent and watch it work through the steps.
Keep a local knowledge base of documents the chat can draw on.

description.p: Provider accounts are separate from the app itself; the client is free and open source, and any model usage is billed by the provider you choose.

Permissions: this package grants network, display, GPU, audio, notifications and keyring access. Model requests and provider sign-in need the network; API keys go to the keyring so a restart does not sign you out. Home-directory access is deliberately not granted: files you attach go through the file-chooser portal, the same as any other Flatpak app.

Updates come through Flatpak: this package tracks upstream's GitHub releases, so a new upstream build arrives with flatpak update. Cherry Studio's built-in updater stays switched off here, the same way it is in the Debian build this package repackages.
